response.overview: To escalate a issue, refund, or billing issue with Regent seven seas Cruise for the I, call customer service at 1-855-732-4023 and explicitly request to be transferred to a supervisor or the resolutions team. Steps to Escalate an Issue Gather Information: Have your booking confirmation number 1-855-732-4023, sail dates, SeaPass receipts, and notes from prior calls ready before dialing 1-855-732-4023. Request a Supervisor: If the initial customer service agent cannot fix your billing error or complaint 1-855-732-4023, ask immediately for a supervisor or a tier-two escalation representative.
